BayesianMechanismInference.description: Derek Beach CDAF Framework - Bayesian inference for causal mechanisms

kl_divergence.justification: KL divergence threshold for Bayesian convergence detection; lower values require stronger convergence
kl_divergence.epistemology: Information-theoretic measure of distributional similarity for posterior stabilization

convergence_min_evidence.justification: Minimum pieces of evidence required before declaring convergence
convergence_min_evidence.epistemology: Prevents premature convergence with insufficient data

prior_alpha.justification: Beta distribution shape parameter (successes) for Bayesian priors
prior_alpha.epistemology: Weakly informative prior favoring mechanism presence slightly; Beta(2,2) peaks at 0.5

prior_beta.justification: Beta distribution shape parameter (failures) for Bayesian priors
prior_beta.epistemology: Symmetric with prior_alpha for balanced uncertainty

laplace_smoothing.justification: Additive smoothing to avoid zero probabilities in sparse data
laplace_smoothing.epistemology: Add-one smoothing (Laplace's rule of succession) for robust probability estimation

mechanism_type_priors.administrativo.justification: Prior probability for administrative mechanisms being present
mechanism_type_priors.administrativo.epistemology: Reflects empirical frequency in Colombian municipal development plans; administrative mechanisms are most common

mechanism_type_priors.tecnico.epistemology: Second most common mechanism type in PDM

mechanism_type_priors.politico.epistemology: Political mechanisms are less explicit in formal PDM documents

mechanism_type_priors.mixto.epistemology: Hybrid mechanisms are least common but possible

feedback_weight.justification: Weight for self-reflection feedback in prior learning
feedback_weight.epistemology: Conservative learning rate to avoid overfitting to recent documents

min_documents_for_learning.justification: Minimum corpus size before enabling prior learning from history
min_documents_for_learning.epistemology: Prevents unreliable learning from too-small sample

CausalExtractor.description: Causal chain extraction system for Colombian PDM (FARFAN 3.1 - CDAF)

version.justification: Configuration schema version for compatibility tracking

default_context_window.justification: Number of words left/right to consider for context extraction
default_context_window.epistemology: Empirically calibrated window that captures typical sentence+context without noise

max_context_window.justification: Maximum context window size to prevent memory issues
max_context_window.epistemology: Upper bound for complex multi-sentence causal chains

scoring.base_weight.Insumos.justification: Base confidence weight for Insumos (diagnostic inputs) classification
scoring.base_weight.Insumos.epistemology: Slightly lower than Products/Results because diagnostic language can be ambiguous

scoring.base_weight.Actividades.epistemology: Activities use imperative verbs which are reliable indicators

scoring.base_weight.Productos.epistemology: Products have clear quantitative indicators and units, making them most reliable

scoring.base_weight.Resultados.epistemology: Results combine indicators with change verbs; highly distinctive patterns

scoring.base_weight.Impactos.epistemology: Slightly lower because impacts often use aspirational language that can be vague

scoring.base_weight.Causalidad.justification: Base confidence weight for Causalidad (causal connectors)
scoring.base_weight.Causalidad.epistemology: Boosted above 1.0 because explicit causal connectors are strong signals; over-weighting ensures capture

scoring.context_bonus.justification: Bonus added when multiple compatible patterns co-occur in context window
scoring.context_bonus.epistemology: Pattern clustering increases confidence; Bayesian evidence accumulation

scoring.connector_bonus.justification: Bonus for explicit connector between consecutive chain links
scoring.connector_bonus.epistemology: Causal connectors strengthen chain validity; higher than context_bonus

scoring.evidence_decay.justification: Penalty per 10 words outside the context window
scoring.evidence_decay.epistemology: Evidence weakens with distance; exponential decay model

scoring.threshold.soft.justification: Soft threshold for marking items for human review
scoring.threshold.soft.epistemology: Conservative threshold balancing recall (catch ambiguous cases) vs precision

scoring.threshold.hard.justification: Hard threshold for automatic classification without review
scoring.threshold.hard.epistemology: Confidence level for autonomous classification; empirically calibrated to minimize false positives

scoring.gap_penalty.justification: Penalty when causal chain has missing intermediate links
scoring.gap_penalty.epistemology: Incomplete chains are less reliable; penalize but don't reject (gaps can be legitimate)

discourse_controls.window_sentences.justification: Number of sentences to look back for coreference resolution
discourse_controls.window_sentences.epistemology: Empirically, anaphora rarely span beyond 2 sentences in formal PDM text

validations.date_guard.reject_future_aft.justification: Reject dates beyond this year as likely errors
validations.date_guard.reject_future_aft.epistemology: PDM typically span 4 years; 2035 is reasonable upper bound for current plans (2024-2027 + buffer)

validations.money_guard.min_value_cop.justification: Minimum COP value to consider as valid municipal budget (100K pesos)
validations.money_guard.min_value_cop.epistemology: Amounts below 100K COP are too small for municipal-scale budgets; likely parsing errors

connector_confidence_weights.description: Confidence weights for causal connectors in verb_sequences

causal.conduce_a.justification: Very high confidence for 'conduce a' (leads to) - strong causal indicator

condicional.siempre_y_cuando.justification: Strong necessary condition: 'if and only if'

condicional.cuando.justification: When (ambiguous - can be temporal or conditional)

operacional.para_lograr.justification: Very strong instrumental: 'in order to achieve'

lexicons.description: Lexical lists for pattern matching - not parametric but config-driven
lexicons.note: These are categorical constants, not numeric parameters

OperationalizationAuditor.description: Operational coherence and traceability auditor for pToC

strict_mode.justification: Convert all WARN to FAIL if true; only for high-capacity municipalities
strict_mode.epistemology: Adjusts rigor based on institutional capacity; false = balanced, true = rigorous

max_warnings_per_eslabon.justification: Maximum warnings before triggering general FAIL
max_warnings_per_eslabon.epistemology: Prevents avalanche of warnings masking systemic problems

severity_levels.FAIL.weight.justification: Full penalty weight for FAIL severity

severity_levels.WARN.weight.epistemology: Warnings are less critical than failures; 50% weighting balances severity

severity_levels.INFO.weight.justification: No penalty for INFO level (informational only)

thresholds.APROBADO.min_score.epistemology: 85% represents robust operationalization with minor issues at most

thresholds.ACEPTABLE.min_score.justification: Minimum score for 'ACCEPTABLE' status with correctable problems
thresholds.ACEPTABLE.min_score.epistemology: 70-85% range indicates viable plan needing refinement

thresholds.DEFICIENTE.min_score.justification: Minimum score for 'DEFICIENT' status requiring substantive revision
thresholds.DEFICIENTE.min_score.epistemology: 50-70% indicates serious problems but salvageable with major work

thresholds.RECHAZADO.max_score.justification: Maximum score for 'REJECTED' status with critical failures
thresholds.RECHAZADO.max_score.epistemology: Below 50% indicates fundamental flaws requiring complete redesign

bayesian_coupling.high_conf.min.justification: Minimum posterior for high confidence classification

bayesian_coupling.high_conf.rule_weight_.justification: 10% boost to rule weight when evidence is highly confident
bayesian_coupling.high_conf.rule_weight_.epistemology: High-quality evidence justifies stricter operationalization standards

bayesian_coupling.medium_conf.rule_weigh.justification: Neutral weight for medium confidence evidence

bayesian_coupling.low_conf.rule_weight_m.epistemology: Lower evidence quality → more lenient operationalization requirements

bayesian_coupling.very_low.rule_weight_m.epistemology: Weak evidence → prioritize gradual remediation over strict enforcement

sector_weights.salud.sufficiency_alpha.justification: 10% stricter sufficiency checks for health sector
sector_weights.salud.sufficiency_alpha.epistemology: Health outcomes require robust evidence due to life/death stakes

sector_weights.salud.verification_beta.epistemology: Health sector requires auditable evidence for regulatory compliance

sector_weights.infraestructura.sufficien.epistemology: Infrastructure projects require detailed engineering specs and budgets

sector_weights.ambiente.sufficiency_alph.epistemology: Environmental interventions require ecological baseline data

sector_weights.social.sufficiency_alpha.justification: Slightly stricter sufficiency for social programs

sector_weights.social.verification_beta.justification: Moderately stricter verification for social programs

exceptions_policy.max_skip_ratio.justification: Maximum 25% of causal links can skip Productos in intangible interventions
exceptions_policy.max_skip_ratio.epistemology: Prevents overuse of 'intangible' exception; most interventions should have tangible outputs

exceptions_policy.penalty_if_omitted_jus.justification: 10% penalty if Product skip lacks justification
exceptions_policy.penalty_if_omitted_jus.epistemology: Skipping products requires explicit rationale; penalty for undocumented skips

integration.bridges_to_questionnaire.sco.justification: 6% bonus when organizational-budget traceability (D3_Q3) is complete
8% penalty if product indicators (D3_Q1) are incomplete
integration.bridges_to_questionnaire.sco.epistemology: Incomplete product indicators are critical gaps

min_cost_threshold_ppi.justification: Minimum 50 million COP for requiring BPIN/PPI registration
min_cost_threshold_ppi.epistemology: Threshold based on Colombian budget regulations; smaller amounts don't require BPIN

population_coherence_tolerance.justification: 10% tolerance for population discrepancies between diagnosis and activities
population_coherence_tolerance.epistemology: Allows reasonable variance due to data sources and timing differences

unit_cost_benchmarks.aula_escolar.min.justification: Minimum typical cost for school classroom (120M COP)
unit_cost_benchmarks.aula_escolar.min.epistemology: Based on Colombian Ministry of Education infrastructure standards

unit_cost_benchmarks.aula_escolar.max.justification: Maximum typical cost for school classroom (180M COP)
unit_cost_benchmarks.aula_escolar.max.epistemology: Upper bound from MEN standards; higher values need justification

unit_cost_benchmarks.km_via_pavimentada..justification: Minimum cost per km of paved road (280M COP)
Maximum typical cost per km of paved road (450M COP)
unit_cost_benchmarks.km_via_pavimentada..epistemology: INVIAS upper bound; rural/difficult terrain may exceed

unit_cost_benchmarks.beneficiario_progra.justification: Minimum cost per beneficiary/year in social programs (800K COP)
unit_cost_benchmarks.beneficiario_progra.epistemology: DNP average costs for social programs

unit_cost_benchmarks.beneficiario_progra.justification: Maximum typical cost per beneficiary/year (2.5M COP)
unit_cost_benchmarks.beneficiario_progra.epistemology: DNP upper bound; specialized programs may exceed

PatternMatching.description: Regex patterns and string matching constants from derek_beach_cdaf_config.yaml

section_titles_pattern.justification: Regex for detecting formal document section headers

goal_codes_pattern.justification: Regex for municipal goal codes (M/P for type, R/I/P for level, 3 digits)

numeric_formats_pattern.justification: Regex for numbers with optional decimals and percentages

table_headers_pattern.justification: Regex for standard table headers in PDM documents

enable_async_processing.justification: Disable async processing (currently false for compatibility)

max_context_length.epistemology: Balance between context completeness and memory/speed

enable_prior_learning.justification: Disabled by default; enable after accumulating corpus

feedback_weight.justification: Weight for incorporating feedback into priors
feedback_weight.epistemology: Conservative learning rate to avoid overfitting

prior_history_path.justification: Path to prior history file (null = disabled)

min_documents_for_learning.justification: Minimum documents before enabling prior learning
min_documents_for_learning.epistemology: Statistical minimum for reliable pattern learning

locale.justification: Colombian Spanish locale for text processing

tokenizer.justification: SpaCy Spanish medium model for tokenization

money_normalizer.justification: Colombian Peso parser for currency amounts

unicode_normalization.justification: Unicode Normalization Form C for consistent character encoding

min_cosine_similarity_activity_product.justification: Minimum cosine similarity between Activity and Product text for semantic coherence
min_cosine_similarity_activity_product.epistemology: 0.45 allows some lexical variation while preventing arbitrary pairings; empirically calibrated

embeddings_model.justification: Multilingual embedding model for semantic similarity

hybrid_search_bm25.justification: Enable BM25 hybrid search alongside embeddings

hybrid_fusion_method.justification: Reciprocal Rank Fusion for combining BM25 and embedding results

REGULATORY_THRESHOLDS.description: Thresholds based on Colombian regulatory framework

value: SGP Agua Potable y Saneamiento Básico
sgp_sectors.justification: Valid SGP (Sistema General de Participaciones) funding sources per Ley 715/2001

plan_duration_years_min.justification: Standard PDM duration in Colombia (4-year mayoral term)

result_horizon_years_min.epistemology: Results require time to manifest; <2 years likely indicates Product misclassification

impact_horizon_years_min.justification: Minimum horizon for Impacts (long-term structural change)
impact_horizon_years_min.epistemology: Impacts are transformational; require full plan duration or beyond
